questions.stem: According to the passage, what teaching method did Aurora Hills Middle School begin using to help new students?
options: Translanguaging
Immersion-only English
Standardized testing
Homeschooling support
questions.evidence: the school system advised teachers to use a method called "translanguaging."
questions.explanation_ko: 학교는 교사들에게 translanguaging이라는 방법을 쓰도록 권했다고 나와 있습니다.

questions.stem: According to the passage, which of the following is NOT something Alisson's teachers did to help her feel more comfortable?
options: Translating lesson words into Spanish
Giving written instructions in Spanish
Asking in Spanish if students had questions
Requiring Alisson to give a speech in English on her first day
questions.evidence: Her teachers had translated words from their lessons into Spanish. They gave out written instructions in Spanish. Some teachers even asked in Spanish if students had finished or had questions.
questions.explanation_ko: 스페인어로 번역, 스페인어 안내문 배포, 스페인어로 질문 확인은 언급되지만 영어 발표를 시켰다는 내용은 없습니다.

questions.stem: What can be inferred from the contrast between teachers' efforts and some city officials' behavior toward new immigrants?
options: City officials and teachers in Aurora have taken the same approach to newcomers.
There is a contrast between the welcoming efforts of teachers and the less welcoming stance of some city officials.
Aurora's public schools have stopped accepting immigrant students.
Teachers in Aurora agree with the city officials' false claims.
questions.evidence: While teachers have been working hard to educate children of immigrants, outside the classrooms, city officials are not as welcoming.
questions.explanation_ko: 교사들은 열심히 이민자 자녀를 교육하는 반면 시 공무원들은 덜 우호적이라는 내용에서, 학교와 시 정부의 태도에 차이가 있음을 추론할 수 있습니다.

questions.stem: Why does the author include the detail that a city official's claim about criminals occupying buildings was investigated by police and found untrue?
options: To show how misinformation about immigrants was spreading despite being disproven
To prove that crime in Aurora had increased
To criticize the police department
To explain how Aurora's housing market works
questions.evidence: The police investigated and found it was not true. But the false claim continued to spread.
questions.explanation_ko: 이 사례는 사실이 아닌 것으로 밝혀졌음에도 이민자에 대한 잘못된 정보가 계속 퍼졌음을 보여 주기 위한 것입니다.

protection given to someone fleeing danger in their home country
a business license
a form of punishment

blanks.sentence_ko: 그리고 스페인어로 대답하는 게 부끄러울 것 같았어요.
그게 저를 기분 나아지게 했어요, 라고 Alisson은 말한다.
그들은 신규 이주민 지원에 돈을 쓰지 않겠다고 약속했고 그들이 이 지역에 오는 것을 막으려 했다.
이 방법은 Alisson이 더 편안하게 느끼도록 도왔다.

key_points: Alisson Ramirez, a Venezuelan teen starting seventh grade in Aurora, Colorado, was nervous about school, but teachers using Spanish translations and instructions helped her feel more comfortable.

While teachers have worked hard to support the roughly 3,000 new immigrant students, some city officials have been unwelcoming, including one who spread a false claim about criminals occupying buildings that police disproved.

Aurora schools adopted a method called 'translanguaging,' allowing students to use Spanish or their home language to help understand English lessons, which has required more work from teachers but drawn little public criticism so far.
Alisson's family fled violence in Venezuela and crossed the Darien Gap to seek asylum, and her mother remains worried about false rumors, including recent bomb threat rumors at the schools.
main_idea: As Aurora, Colorado's schools adapt teaching methods like translanguaging to support thousands of new immigrant students from Venezuela and Colombia, families still face an unwelcoming climate driven by false rumors from some city officials.
restate_sentence: That means using Spanish or the home language at times to help new students understand English lessons and discussions happening around them.
